title: Returns and refunds policy
body: You can return or get a refund for an item within 30 days of delivery. Items must be unused or defective. Refunds go back to the original payment method within 5 business days. Refunds cannot exceed the order total. Orders delivered more than 30 days ago are outside the return window and need a human to review.

title: Shipping times and tracking
body: Standard shipping takes 3-5 business days and express shipping takes 1-2 business days. Orders leave the warehouse within 1 business day. A tracking number is emailed when the order ships. Orders can be cancelled only before they ship.

title: Warranty coverage
body: All products carry a 1-year limited warranty against manufacturing defects. Accidental damage and normal wear are not covered. To claim, contact support with your order number and a description of the problem.

title: Payment methods
body: We accept major credit cards and PayPal. You are charged when the order ships.
